text:
It could be that everything I have felt in verse

was nothing more than what could never be,

nothing more than something forbidden and repressed

from family to family, from woman to woman.


They say that in the ancestral houses of my people, measured

was everything that had to be done...

They say the women were silent

in my maternal house... Ah, it could well be...


At times in my mother cravings emerged

to free herself, but there rose to her eyes

a deep bitterness, and in the shadow she wept.


And all this biting, conquered, mutilated,

all this that was locked inside her soul,

I think that without wishing it I have set free.

translation.title: It Could Be
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the generational feminist argument direct and legible.
